regime_context: China A-shares thematic detector as of 2026-09-30 shows a narrow, non-directional, two-horse tape: Banks lead (rank 1, score 0.998, eligible) with Innovative Pharma & CXO nearly tied (0.988, eligible), and only 4 of 22 themes are trend-gate eligible (frac 0.18, view 'narrow'). Critically, gate_helps is FALSE on this market's history and dir_accuracy is 0.377 — the trend discipline did not cut drawdown here and my past directional calls have been worse than coin-flips, so I default to low conviction and few theses.
emerging_watch: Watch Coal (cn_coal) with a HURST tag of 'mean-revert' and breadth of only 0.30: if Coal's absolute trend remains eligible AND its breadth expands above roughly 0.5 for five consecutive sessions without the CSI 300 rolling over, I would retire this watch and consider it a genuine rotation candidate — until then it is just a narrow mean-reverting bounce.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the challenger to Banks with a near-identical momentum score (0.988 vs 0.998) but a lower crowding_z (1.59 vs 1.78) and a comparable-to-stronger durability_bar (0.60; not the leader's 0.73 but solidly eligible). The rotation margin is razor-thin (0.01) and breadth_of_rotation is narrow but not one-narrative, so leadership is contested rather than settled. Given crowd-caution on the leader and similar momentum, a relative lean toward the challenger is a modest, falsifiable judgment — not a prediction. The absolute-trend gate is eligible here, but because gate_helps is false on this tape, I treat that as a de-risk filter only, not confidence.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.59 is still crowded and the theme may be riding a single-narrative attention spike; breadth is only 0.643 versus Banks' 0.889, so the move is narrower and more fragile if the specific pharma/CXO catalyst stalls.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags 512800.SS by 5% on a total-return basis before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the leader with the highest score, the highest durability_bar (0.73), and the widest breadth (0.889), so it is a legitimate trend-following candidate. But it is the most crowded (z 1.78), and given gate_helps is false, the trend discipline's only validated value (drawdown control) did not hold on this market — so there is no reason to expect it to outperform from here; this is a hold/remain-exposed lean, not an add. The crowding flag is a cap/down-size caution, never a fade.
evidence: crowding_z 1.78, crowded true — size-down caution only
theses.dissent: Crowding is at a reflexivity risk zone: if the flow that carried Banks stalls, the wide breadth could unwind broadly across Financials & Value, and the HURST tag is 'mixed' so the trend itself is not cleanly directional.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 benchmark by 3% on a total-return basis before the 20-day check-by date
